name: Westbrook Garrison Needs Help!
summary: Marshal Dughan sends available adventurers west to Westbrook Garrison, the outpost at Elwynn Forest's border with Westfall. Stormwind's army is stretched thin across the kingdom, while Deputy Rainer and his guards face growing pressure from Riverpaw gnolls and wandering thieves without regular reinforcements.

sections.title: A Frontier Stretched Thin
sections.body: Westbrook Garrison guards the western edge of Elwynn Forest, where settled woodland meets Westfall's troubled plains. Gnoll warbands and bandits grow bolder along the waterways and western roads, and the small garrison has asked for more men. Marshal Dughan and Goldshire's administration have no Stormwind soldiers to spare. Local commanders must hire traveling mercenaries and wandering adventurers.

sections.title: The Threat Across the Brook
sections.body: Deputy Rainer and his men face the Riverpaw gnolls, whose raiding parties harass travelers and nearby homesteads. The pack operates in the borderlands between Elwynn and Westfall. With Stormwind distracted by political and military troubles, the gnolls press deeper into inhabited territory. Westbrook Garrison guards against their unchecked advance into the heart of the forest.

faq.q: Why can't Stormwind send regular soldiers to Westbrook Garrison?
faq.answer: Stormwind's standing military is stretched thin across several frontiers. With King Varian Wrynn missing and the realm beset by internal strife, high command has refused or been unable to send regular soldiers to rural outposts. Town marshals like Dughan must rely on freelance volunteers.
Westbrook Garrison sits on Elwynn Forest's western edge. Follow the main road west from Goldshire, past the small brook. The fortified tower stands on your right, just before the Westfall border.

faq.q: What threats are troubling the garrison?
faq.answer: Deputy Rainer faces repeated raids by Riverpaw gnolls, along with growing thief and bandit activity in the border country between Westfall and Elwynn Forest.

Deputy Rainer is the Stormwind officer in command at Westbrook Garrison. He must hold the western border and rely on civilian volunteers and mercenaries because official military reinforcements are scarce.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Deputy Rainer?
faq.answer: Deputy Rainer enlists your help against the local Riverpaw gnolls. He places a bounty on their collars to thin their numbers and protect the border road.

faq.q: Why are the gnolls pushing into Elwynn Forest?
faq.answer: The Riverpaw gnolls have camps along the rivers that separate Elwynn and Westfall. With fewer soldiers along the border, they have grown bold enough to raid trade routes and press toward Elwynn's interior farms.

angles.text: As a human of Stormwind, you see an unsettling sign of the kingdom's neglect. The crown's defenses have worn thin since the King's disappearance.
As an Alliance volunteer, you take up the work of regular soldiers and help keep core territories from descending into complete chaos.
